page.title: CurryClub — A global social network for curry lovers

findings.title: One h3 is a different size from the other 5
findings.evidence: “ACTIVE NOW” is 12px; the other h3s are 24px (12px ×1, 24px ×5). Same semantic level should get the same treatment.
findings.fix: Pick one size for h3 and set it once in CSS. If one of these is really a sub-heading, change its tag instead of its size.
findings.citation: UICrit: elements at the same level of hierarchy should get similar graphic treatment (Duan et al., UIST '24)

findings.title: Row items are off by a few pixels
findings.evidence: span#lovable-badge-text “Edit with” and span#lovable-badge-logo sit in the same row but their top edges differ by 2px (870 vs 868). 1px is sub-pixel noise; 2–3px is a mistake, not a decision.
findings.fix: Align them on the same axis: use align-items on the parent, or give both the same margin-top. If the offset is intentional, make it ≥ 8px so it reads as deliberate.

findings.title: Text sits too close to its box edge (×2)
findings.evidence: div.relative.flex: the text is 1/1/1/1px (top/right/bottom/left) from the box edge at 16px text; 4 sides are under 3px.
findings.fix: Give the box at least 8px on every side (about half the font size).

findings.title: Pulsing status dot
findings.fix: Small pulsing status dots simulate liveness decoratively. Reserve pulse animation for indicators tied to genuinely live, changing data; a static indicator with clear labeling is honest and calmer.

findings.title: Eyebrow label above the hero headline
findings.evidence: “Live · 2,402 feasts this week” (10px, tracked caps) sits directly above a 96px h1. The tiny label + giant headline pairing is the default generated SaaS hero.
findings.fix: Fold the label into the headline or the first sentence. If it's an announcement, make it a real link somewhere else.

findings.title: 12 tracked all-caps section labels
findings.evidence: Small uppercase, letter-spaced labels like “Live · 2,402 feasts this week” above sections. On 10.5% of Show HN launches, and usually redundant with the heading under them.
findings.fix: Delete the label or fold its word into the heading.

findings.title: Head is missing: canonical
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD structured data either, so AI search engines have nothing to cite. One h1, good.
findings.fix: Ten minutes of <head> work: title under 60 chars, canonical URL, lang attribute, favicon, and an Organization or WebSite JSON-LD block.

findings.title: 29 words under 12px on a phone
findings.evidence: 4 text blocks render below 12px at 390px, e.g. span.mb-4.inline-block “Live · 2,402 feasts this week” at 10px.
findings.fix: Body text 16px on mobile; nothing readable under 12px. If the desktop size is in px, use clamp() or a mobile breakpoint.

findings.title: Repeating-gradient stripes
findings.fix: Repeating-gradient stripes used as surface decoration are a recurring generated-UI signature. Reach for a deliberate texture or leave the surface plain.
